mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO creator_follow (creator_id, follower_id) SELECT p.user_id, u.id FROM creator_profile p INNER JOIN identity_user u ON u.id = #{followerId} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE p.user_id = #{creatorId} AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM creator_follow WHERE creator_id = #{creatorId} AND follower_id = #{followerId}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM creator_follow WHERE creator_id = #{creatorId} AND follower_id = #{followerId})
mapper.update: UPDATE creator_profile SET follower_count = follower_count + 1 WHERE user_id = #{creatorId}
UPDATE creator_profile SET follower_count = GREATEST(follower_count - 1, 0) WHERE user_id = #{creatorId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.user_id, p.slug, p.display_name, p.headline, p.bio, p.avatar_url, p.banner_url, p.status, p.version, p.follower_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM creator_follow f INNER JOIN creator_profile p ON p.user_id = f.creator_id WHERE f.follower_id = #{followerId} AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, p.user_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM creator_follow f INNER JOIN creator_profile p ON p.user_id = f.creator_id WHERE f.follower_id = #{followerId} AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'
